'''Jelpel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was the leader of the [[Kajidier]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Hutt clan]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Kajidier was heavily involved in the recruitment of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] security guards to serve the Hutts and Jelpel took great pride from providing his clients with security guards suited to their specific requirements.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
